title: Stargate as a vestibule for a deeper black program; Pat Price

tellings.quote: The SRRI stargate program, etc. was shut down in '95 was really actually like a a >> vestibule >> for a darker deep black project that still exists. the one that you know Pat Price uh was recruited into and killed over.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that Stargate, a US government program run partly at the Stanford Research Institute, a California research lab, that tried to use the mind to see distant places, was shut down in 1995 but was really just a front room for a darker, deeply secret project that still exists. He says a man named Pat Price, who took part in that work, was recruited into the deeper project and was killed over it. If true, it would mean the government's mind research never really ended.
